text: In Grafana, create a NEW dashboard (from the top bar: Dashboards > New dashboard, or the + Create button). Add a visualization panel. In the query editor, select the data source named TestData (it may be listed as 'TestData DB' or 'TestData' - choose the TestData one), and leave the default scenario (e.g. Random Walk) so the query returns data. Change the panel's visualization type to Stat (use the visualization picker on the right side, search for Stat). Set the panel title to exactly: fwgr75-n1 Availability (in the right-side Panel options, the Panel title field). Then save the dashboard: click the Save dashboard button in the top right, and in the save dialog set the dashboard name to exactly: fwgr75-n1 Bench Dashboard, then click Save/Change. Confirm the save succeeded (a 'Dashboard saved' toast or the dashboard is no longer in unsaved state). Report the panel title shown on the dashboard, the data source name shown in the query editor, the dashboard title shown in the breadcrumb/top bar, and the browser page URL.
